durability_thresholds.title: Durability Thresholds
durability_thresholds.description:
The list of both durability thresholds and effects emitted when each threshold is met. When multiple thresholds are met, only the threshold with the lowest durability after applying the damage is considered.

Properties:
• sound_event (string) = undefined
• durability (int) = 0
• particle_type (string) = none

defaultSnippets.label: Item Components Durability Sensor Durability Threshold
defaultSnippets.description: Defines both the durability threshold, and the effects emitted when that threshold is met.

durability.title: durability
durability.description: The effects are emitted when the item durability value is less than or equal to this value.

particle_type.title: enum ParticleType
particle_type.description: Particle effect to emit when the threshold is met.

item_components_minecraft_dyeable.title: Item Components Dyeable
item_components_minecraft_dyeable.description: enables custom items to be dyed in cauldrons. To use the dyeable component, the format version on the item and the attachable needs to have a format_version of 1.21.30 or greater.

defaultSnippets.label: Default Color (default)
defaultSnippets.description: Use default value: 255,255,255

item_components_minecraft_enchantable.title: Item Components Enchantable
item_components_minecraft_enchantable.description: Determines what enchantments can be applied to the item. Not all enchantments will have an effect on all item components.

slot.title: Slot
slot.description:
Specifies which types of enchantments can be applied. For example, `bow` would allow this item to be enchanted as if it were a bow.

Sample values:
• chestplate: armor_torso
• my_boots: armor_feet
• my_helm: armor_head

value.title: Value
value.description:
Specifies the value of the enchantment (minimum of 0).

Sample values:
• chestplate: 10

item_components_minecraft_entity_placer.title: Item Components Entity Placer
item_components_minecraft_entity_placer.description: Allows an item to place entities into the world. Additionally, in version 1.19.80 and above, the component allows the item to set the spawn type of a monster spawner.

dispense_on.title: dispense_on
dispense_on.description:
List of block descriptors of the blocks that this item can be dispensed on. If left empty, all blocks will be allowed.

Properties:
• name (string) = 
• states (int) = {}
• tags (string) =

entity.title: Entity
entity.description:
The entity to be placed in the world.

Sample values:
• my_sword_turtle: minecraft:turtle

use_on.title: use_on
use_on.description:
List of block descriptors of the blocks that this item can be used on. If left empty, all blocks will be allowed.

Properties:
• name (string) = 
• states (int) = {}
• tags (string) = 

Sample values:
• my_sword_turtle: ["minecraft:sand"]

item_components_minecraft_food.title: Item Components Food
item_components_minecraft_food.description: Sets the item as a food component, allowing it to be edible to the player.

remove_effects.title: Remove Effects
remove_effects.description:
[DEPRECATED] Array of effect names to remove when eating this food. This property was deprecated and is no longer supported in newer versions.

*⚠️ Deprecated since 1.20.0*

can_always_eat.title: Can Always Eat
can_always_eat.description:
If true you can always eat this item (even when not hungry). Default is set to false.

Sample values:
• appleEnchanted: true

nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.description:
Value that is added to the entity's nutrition when the item is used. Default is set to 0.

Sample values:
• apple: 4
• baked_potato: 5
• beef: 3

saturation_modifier.title: Saturation Modifier
saturation_modifier.description:
saturation_modifier is used in this formula: (nutrition * saturation_modifier * 2) when applying the saturation buff. Default is set to 0.6.

Sample values:
• apple: 0.3
• appleEnchanted: supernatural
• baked_potato: normal

using_converts_to.title: Using Converts To
using_converts_to.description:
When used, converts to the item specified by the string in this field. Default does not convert item.

Sample values:
• beetroot_soup: bowl
• honey_bottle: glass_bottle

defaultSnippets.label: Using Converts To (default)
defaultSnippets.description: Use default value: [object Object]

effects.title: Effects
effects.description:
Properties:
• name (string)
• chance (number)
• duration (number)
• amplifier (number)

Sample values:
• appleEnchanted: [{"name":"regeneration","chance":1,"duration":3...
• chicken: [{"name":"hunger","chance":0.3,"duration":30,"a...

item_components_minecraft_projectile.title: Item Components Projectile
item_components_minecraft_projectile.description: Defines an item as a projectile that can be shot from dispensers or used as ammunition with minecraft:shooter. When combined with minecraft:throwable, this component specifies which entity is spawned when the item is thrown.

projectile_entity.title: Projectile Entity
projectile_entity.description:
Which entity is to be fired as a projectile.

Sample values:
• wind_charge: wind_charge_projectile
• my_sword_chuck: minecraft:snowball

minimum_critical_power.title: Minimum Critical Power
minimum_critical_power.description:
Specifies how long a player must charge a projectile for it to critically hit.

Sample values:
• my_sword_chuck: 1.25

item_components_minecraft_record.title: Item Components Record
item_components_minecraft_record.description: Used by record items to play music.

sound_event.title: Sound Event
sound_event.description:
Sound event type: 13, cat, blocks, chirp, far, mall, mellohi, stal, strad, ward, 11, wait, pigstep, otherside, 5, relic.

Sample values:
• my_sword_singing: pre_ram.screamer

comparator_signal.title: Comparator Signal
comparator_signal.description:
Specifies signal strength for comparator blocks to use, from 1 - 13.

Sample values:
• my_sword_singing: 1

duration.title: Duration
duration.description:
Specifies duration of sound event in seconds, float value.

Sample values:
• my_sword_singing: 5

item_components_minecraft_repairable.title: Item Components Repairable
item_components_minecraft_repairable.description: Defines the items that can be used to repair a defined item, and the amount of durability each item restores upon repair. Each entry needs to define a list of strings for 'items' that can be used for the repair and an optional 'repair_amount' for how much durability is repaired.

items.title: Items
items.description: Items that may be used to repair an item.

repair_amount.title: Repair Amount
repair_amount.description: How much the item is repaired.

defaultSnippets.label: Repair Items (object)
defaultSnippets.description: Use Repair Items as an object

repair_items.title: Repair Items
repair_items.description:
List of repair item entries. Each entry needs to define a list of strings for `items` that can be used for the repair and an optional `repair_amount` for how much durability is gained.

Sample values:
• chestplate: [{"items":["minecraft:stick"],"repair_amount":"...
• my_sword_chuck: [{"items":["minecraft:diamond"],"repair_amount"...

defaultSnippets.label: Repair Items (object)
defaultSnippets.description: Use Repair Items as an object

item_components_ammunition.title: Item Components Ammunition
item_components_ammunition.description: Is ammunition for a shooter item.

search_inventory.title: Search Inventory
search_inventory.description: Can search inventory? Default is set to false.

use_in_creative.title: Use In Creative
use_in_creative.description: Can use in creative mode? Default is set to false.

use_offhand.title: Use Offhand
use_offhand.description: Can use off-hand? Default is set to false.

item_components_minecraft_shooter.title: Item Components Shooter
item_components_minecraft_shooter.description: Compels an item to shoot projectiles, similarly to a bow or crossbow. Must have the minecraft:use_modifiers component in order to function properly.

ammunition.title: Ammunition
ammunition.description:
A list of ammunition entries that define which items can be used as projectiles for this shooter. Each entry specifies the item, whether to search the offhand, inventory, and whether to use in creative mode.

Properties:
• item (string)
• search_inventory (boolean) = false
• use_in_creative (boolean) = false
• use_offhand (boolean) = false

Sample values:
• my_sword_shoot: [{"item":"minecraft:snowball","use_offhand":tru...

defaultSnippets.label: Item Components Ammunition
defaultSnippets.description: Is ammunition for a shooter item.

scale_power_by_draw_duration.title: Scale Power By Draw Duration
scale_power_by_draw_duration.description:
When true, the projectile's launch power increases based on how long the player holds the use button before releasing. Default is false.

Sample values:
• my_sword_shoot: true

max_draw_duration.title: Max Draw Duration
max_draw_duration.description:
The maximum time in seconds that a player can draw the shooter before it automatically fires or reaches maximum power. Default is 0.

Sample values:
• my_sword_shoot: 1

charge_on_draw.title: Charge On Draw
charge_on_draw.description: When true, the shooter begins charging when the player starts drawing, similar to a crossbow. Default is false.

item_components_minecraft_storage_item.title: Item Components Storage Item
item_components_minecraft_storage_item.description: Enables an item to store data of the dynamic container associated with it. A dynamic container is a container for storing items that is linked to an item instead of a block or an entity.

allow_nested_storage_items.title: Allow Nested Storage Items
allow_nested_storage_items.description:
Determines whether another Storage Item is allowed inside of this item. Default is true.

Sample values:
• black_bundle: true

allowed_items.title: Allowed Items
allowed_items.description: List of items that are exclusively allowed in this Storage Item. If empty all items are allowed.

defaultSnippets.label: Allowed Items (default)
defaultSnippets.description: Use default value:

banned_items.title: Banned Items
banned_items.description:
List of items that are not allowed in this Storage Item.

Sample values:
• black_bundle: ["minecraft:shulker_box","minecraft:undyed_shul...

defaultSnippets.label: Banned Items (default)
defaultSnippets.description: Use default value:

max_slots.title: Max Slots
max_slots.description:
The maximum allowed weight of the sum of all contained items. Maximum is 64. Default is 64.

Sample values:
• black_bundle: 64

item_components_minecraft_storage_weight.title: Item Components Storage Weight Limit
item_components_minecraft_storage_weight.description: Specifies the maximum weight limit that a storage item can hold

max_weight_limit.title: Max Weight Limit
max_weight_limit.description: The maximum allowed weight of the sum of all contained items. Maximum is 64. Default is 64.

item_components_minecraft_storage_weight.title: Item Components Storage Weight Modifier
item_components_minecraft_storage_weight.description: Specifies the maximum weight limit that a storage item can hold

weight_in_storage_item.title: Weight In Storage Item
weight_in_storage_item.description: The weight of this item when inside another Storage Item. Default is 4. 0 means item is not allowed in another Storage Item.

item_components_minecraft_tags.title: Item Components Tags
item_components_minecraft_tags.description: Determines which tags are included on a given item

tags.title: Tags
tags.description:
An array that can contain multiple item tags.

Sample values:
• apple: ["minecraft:is_food"]

item_components_minecraft_throwable.title: Item Components Throwable
item_components_minecraft_throwable.description: Makes an item throwable by the player, similar to a snowball or ender pearl. Use with minecraft:projectile to specify which entity is spawned when thrown.

do_swing_animation.title: Do Swing Animation
do_swing_animation.description:
Determines whether the item should use the swing animation when thrown. Default is set to false.

Sample values:
• wind_charge: true

launch_power_scale.title: Launch Power Scale
launch_power_scale.description:
The scale at which the power of the throw increases. Default is set to 1.0.

Sample values:
• wind_charge: 1.5
• my_sword_chuck: 1

max_draw_duration.title: Max Draw Duration
max_draw_duration.description: The maximum duration to draw a throwable item. Default is set to 0.0.

max_launch_power.title: Max Launch Power
max_launch_power.description:
The maximum power to launch the throwable item. Default is set to 1.0.

Sample values:
• wind_charge: 1.5
• my_sword_chuck: 1

min_draw_duration.title: Min Draw Duration
min_draw_duration.description: The minimum duration to draw a throwable item. Default is set to 0.0.

scale_power_by_draw_duration.title: Scale Power By Draw Duration
scale_power_by_draw_duration.description: Whether or not the power of the throw increases with duration charged. Default is set to false.

item_components_minecraft_use_modifiers.title: Item Components Use Modifiers
item_components_minecraft_use_modifiers.description: Determines how long an item takes to use in combination with components such as Shooter, Throwable, or Food.

emit_vibrations.title: Emit Vibrations
emit_vibrations.description: Whether vibrations are emitted when the item starts or stops being used.

movement_modifier.title: Movement Modifier
movement_modifier.description:
Multiplier applied to the player's movement speed while the item is in use.

Sample values:
• apple: 0.35

start_sound.title: LevelSoundEvent
start_sound.description: Sound played when the item starts being used.

use_duration.title: Use Duration
use_duration.description:
Time, in seconds, that the item takes to use.

Sample values:
• apple: 1.6

item_components_minecraft_wearable.title: Item Components Wearable
item_components_minecraft_wearable.description: Sets the wearable item component, which allows an item to be worn by a player in a specified equipment slot.

slot.title: Equipment Slot
slot.description:
Specifies where the item can be worn. If any non-hand slot is chosen, the max stack size is set to 1.

Sample values:
• chestplate: slot.armor.chest
• crown: slot.armor.head
• my_boots: slot.armor.feet

hides_player_location.title: Hides Player Location
hides_player_location.description: Determines whether the Player's location is hidden on Locator Maps and the Locator Bar when the wearable item is worn. Default is false.

protection.title: Protection
protection.description: How much protection the wearable item provides. Default is set to 0.
